title: Bait-and-Recover: Poisoning Internal Refusal Signals to Defend LLMs against White-Box Editing Jailbreaks
abstract: arXiv:2609.05794v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight large language models face a low-cost white-box threat from representation engineering attacks. Attackers can estimate refusal directions and search for projection-matrix edits that suppress safety alignment while preserving general capabilities, within minutes on a single GPU and without gradient-based training. We propose Bait-and-Recover, a weight-level defense that places a bait adapter where attackers read activations and a paired recovery adapter at the subsequent layer. Trained via gradient routing, this decouples the observation path from the behavior path. By actively poisoning the residual signal used for measurement, Bait-and-Recover disrupts the attacker's edit search, while the recovery layer restores clean downstream computation. Across four open-weight models, our defense raises the minimum refusal rate against white-box edit searches from 16.25% to 71.75% under a strict behavior-preservation budget (KL <= 0.

translated_title: 诱饵与恢复：通过投毒内部拒绝信号防御大语言模型免受白盒编辑越狱攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05794v1 公告类型： cross 摘要： 开放权重的大语言模型面临着来自表示工程攻击的低成本白盒威胁。攻击者可以在几分钟内、于单块GPU上估计拒绝方向并搜索投影矩阵编辑，在抑制安全对齐的同时保留模型的通用能力，且无需基于梯度的训练。我们提出Bait-and-Recover（诱饵与恢复），这是一种权重级别的防御方法，它在攻击者读取激活值的位置放置一个诱饵适配器，并在后续层放置一个与之配对的恢复适配器。通过梯度路由进行训练，该方法将观察路径与行为路径解耦。通过主动投毒用于测量的残差信号，Bait-and-Recover干扰了攻击者的编辑搜索，而恢复层则还原了干净的下游计算。在四个开放权重模型上，我们的防御方法在严格的行为保持预算（KL ≤ 0.…）约束下，将针对白盒编辑搜索的最低拒绝率从16.25%提升至71.75%。
tldr: 提出Bait-and-Recover权重级防御方法，通过在攻击者读取激活值处放置诱饵适配器并在后续层放置恢复适配器，主动投毒攻击者依赖的内部拒绝信号以破坏其白盒编辑搜索，同时保持模型正常行为，将最低拒绝率从16.25%提升至71.75%。
en_tdlr: Bait-and-Recover is a weight-level defense that poisons the internal refusal signals attackers rely on for white-box editing, using a bait adapter at the attack read-out point and a paired recovery adapter at the next layer, raising minimum refusal rates from 16.25% to 71.75% while preserving model behavior.
